context: Re-adjudicate the already-committed 180-run v5 responses offline first, which costs zero quota and settles whether the taxonomy alone explains the blockers, before designing a v6 contract. Split the decision field into separate factual-outcome, action-safety, evidence-contribution, and temporal-disposition fields with independent scoring, so a correct-but-differently-labeled answer cannot register as a safety failure while genuinely unsafe behavior still does. Only after Joe authorizes new quota does a v6 pilot run.
description: Three gate generations (v3, v4, v5) each ended no-promote, and v5 isolated the cause: the single 'decision' response field conflates factual outcome, action safety, evidence contribution, and temporal disposition. All 20 v5 treatment safety flags were decision-label mismatches with behaviorally safe answers (answers explicitly refuse execution, report class-only, declare worktrees inactive); baseline had 17 and control 21 of the same class, so the penalty is arm-independent and cannot be fixed by any candidate rewrite. v5 otherwise beat baseline on correctness 0.9662, recall 0.9833, and payload -49 percent. Evidence reports/promotion-decision-v5-codex.md, reports/ab-results-v5-codex.json, commits 6afbf6d and f801885.
